AstroStake is a community-driven validator and infrastructure provider, built with enterprise-grade reliability and a focus on high-uptime, secure node operations.

Networks we are currently validating: Lumera, 0G, Epix, Safrochain, Lumen, and 5+ additional testnets, including gno.land.

Digital presence: Website - https://astrostake.xyz | GitHub - github.com/astrostake | Twitter/X - x.com/astrostake

Contact: reach us via our website or Twitter/X above.

Why we're interested in validating on gno.land: we're drawn to Gno's deterministic Go-based smart contract model and Tendermint2 consensus design, and want to help stress-test and support the network through its testnet phase ahead of mainnet.

Contributions: we maintain public setup guides and cheat sheets for running gno.land topaz-1 nodes/validators on our docs site, and build supporting infrastructure tooling that we plan to extend to gno.land as the ecosystem matures.
